REQ-001.design_rationale: Section 2.1 and Section 12.1 establish Sources/OpenKey/macOS-Swift/ compiling clean engine entry points (OKEngineInit, OKEngineSyncConfig, OKEngineHandleKeyEvent, OKEngineResetSession, OKEngineKeyCodeToChar, OKHookSnapshot) to Swift and unit tests without code duplication.
REQ-001.tasks_rationale: Task 2 establishes package scaffold, Task 4 produces executable .app bundle, and Task 8 ports engine directly into OpenKeySwiftCore.
REQ-001.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1, Section 2.2, and Section 2.8 (release bundle build and packaging).

REQ-002.design_rationale: Section 2.2 specifies an unsandboxed application bundle (OpenKeySwift.entitlements omitting sandbox), 1.0s accessibility polling via AXIsProcessTrusted(), automatic event tap registration upon trust, timeout/wake recovery (NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification), and private CGEventSource tagging (0xBEEF) to prevent feedback loops.
REQ-002.tasks_rationale: Task 2 specifies unsandboxed entitlements, Task 3 implements EventTapCoordinator.swift with AXIsProcessTrusted polling, self-event tagging (0xBEEF), and timeout recovery, and Task 7 hardens sleep/wake recovery.
REQ-002.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.2, Section 2.3, Section 2.5 (live WindowServer tap PID=96707), Section 2.6 (tap ID=1424268980), and Section 2.10 (deployed process PID=97778).

REQ-003.design_rationale: Section 2.3 and Section 12.1 define OpenKeySettingsStore synchronization of engine globals supporting strictly Telex (0) and VNI (1), precomposed Unicode only (vCodeTable = 0), and auto-restore on invalid Vietnamese sequences via vRestore and vRestoreAndStartNewSession.
REQ-003.tasks_rationale: Task 3 wires OpenKeySettingsStore.swift, Task 5 verifies composition and auto-restore, Task 6 clamps inputType to Telex/VNI, Task 7 flattens codeTable, and Task 8 ports full syllable composition to Swift.
REQ-003.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1 (Telex/VNI syllable composition tests pass), Section 2.5 (live typing 'tiếng việt'), and Section 2.7 (13/13 tests pass).

REQ-004.design_rationale: Section 2.4 specifies EventTapCoordinator bypassing Vietnamese composition on Spotlight overlay (width >= 200 && height >= 40), terminal emulators, VM/remote-desktop apps, and Cmd+Tab / modifier shortcuts, with app-aware U+200C (Sublime Text) vs U+202F breaker in KeystrokeInjector when extCode != 4.
REQ-004.tasks_rationale: Task 3 implements KeystrokeInjector and EventTapCoordinator, Task 6 implements terminal/Spotlight bypass, and Task 7 adds VM bundle IDs, dimension-filtered Spotlight detection, and app-aware U+200C vs U+202F breaker.
REQ-004.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1, Section 2.5 (live TailTap captures U+202F breaker), and Section 2.7 (terminal app detection test passes).

REQ-005.design_rationale: Section 2.5 and Section 12.1 design configurable per-app smart language switching (useSmartSwitchKey, default true), synchronization of manual toggles to OKSetAppInputMethodStatus and UserDefaults, and bounds-checked deserialization in SmartSwitchKey.
REQ-005.tasks_rationale: Task 1 adds bounds checking, Task 3 wires focus tracking, Task 6 fixes language revert, Task 7 verifies per-app vs global switching, and Task 8 ports SmartSwitchKey to pure Swift.
REQ-005.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1 (bounds-checked deserialization on truncated buffers passes), Section 2.4 (bounds check git diff), and Section 2.7 (SmartSwitchKey persistence and lookup passes).

REQ-006.design_rationale: Section 2.6 specifies leak-free TISCopyCurrentKeyboardInputSource() handling, InputSourceGuard notification caching (kTISNotifySelectedKeyboardInputSourceChanged), and non-QWERTY rejection (Dvorak, Colemak, AZERTY).
REQ-006.tasks_rationale: Task 1 fixes TISCopyCurrentKeyboardInputSource leak in OpenKey.mm, Task 3 implements InputSourceGuard.swift, and Task 7 adds notification caching and non-QWERTY layout rejection.
REQ-006.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1, Section 2.4, and Section 2.7 (InputSourceGuard repeated invocation safety passes 1,000 iterations).

REQ-007.design_rationale: Section 2.7 designs HotKeyMatcher with default Option + Z (0x7A000206), auto-repeat suppression, matching keyUp swallowing, and safe modifier-only clean-release state machine.
REQ-007.tasks_rationale: Task 3 implements HotKeyMatcher.swift, Task 4 provides shortcut recorder UI, and Task 7 implements auto-repeat suppression, keyUp swallowing, and modifier-only clean-release state machine.
REQ-007.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1 and Section 2.7 (HotKeyMatcher default and custom patterns pass).

REQ-008.design_rationale: Section 2.8 specifies OpenKeySwiftApp with cached monochrome template icons, checkable per-app memory menu item, grouped Form SettingsView, interactive shortcut recorder, and SMAppService.mainApp error recovery.
REQ-008.tasks_rationale: Task 4 implements OpenKeySwiftApp.swift and SettingsView.swift, Task 6 adds cached monochrome icons, and Task 7 adds top-section per-app toggle, interactive recorder, and Launch-at-Login rollback.
REQ-008.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.1, Section 2.2, Section 2.7 (OpenKeySettingsStore persistence and sync pass), and Section 2.8 (app bundle packaging).

REQ-009.design_rationale: Section 2.9 specifies build-app.sh Keychain signing identity auto-detection, --setup-cert helper for local certificate generation, and signing with --identifier com.tuyenmai.openkey.swift and designated requirement.
REQ-009.tasks_rationale: Task 7 explicitly updates build-app.sh with identity auto-detection, --setup-cert, and explicit designated requirement.
REQ-009.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.2, Section 2.3, and Section 2.8 (codesign verification with designated requirement).

REQ-010.design_rationale: Section 2.10 specifies EventTapCoordinator ordering fast path in strict O(1) order: self-event filtering, mouse reset, hotkey processing, modifier shortcut bypass, non-keyDown return, and English mode immediate return before any IPC checks, with 0.15s TTL + dimension-filtered Spotlight detection.
REQ-010.tasks_rationale: Task 7 explicitly implements zero-IPC fast-path ordering, 0.15s TTL + dimension-filtered Spotlight detection, and activeAppBundleId caching.
REQ-010.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.5 (zero-IPC live event processing) and Section 2.7 (swift test passes with fast-path routing).

REQ-011.design_rationale: Section 2.10 specifies EventTapCoordinator.evaluateKeyEvent(_ context: KeyEventContext) -> EventTapAction pure value-type routing function handling all bypasses, hotkey swallowing, modifier-only tap transitions, and engine dispatch without live CGEventTap dependencies.
REQ-011.tasks_rationale: Task 7 explicitly implements evaluateKeyEvent with KeyEventContext and EventTapAction, and unit tests covering every routing branch.
REQ-011.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.7 (Pure Event Routing Pipeline evaluateKeyEvent test passes).

REQ-012.design_rationale: Section 2.1 and Section 2.3 specify deleting ConvertTool.h/.cpp and Macro.h/.cpp from Sources/OpenKey/engine/, flattening _codeTable to single Precomposed Unicode map, and stripping all dead globals and dead branches across Engine.h/.cpp and OpenKeyEngineBridge.mm.
REQ-012.tasks_rationale: Task 7 explicitly deletes ConvertTool and Macro files, flattens Vietnamese _codeTable, and strips dead globals and dead branches across C++ engine and bridge.
REQ-012.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.9 (git status showing deletion of ConvertTool and Macro and simplification of DataType/Engine/Vietnamese).

REQ-013.design_rationale: Section 2.8 and ADR-010 specify Package.swift targeting .macOS("26.0"), Info.plist LSMinimumSystemVersion = 26.0, OpenKeySettingsStore @Observable migration with zero Combine dependencies, and SettingsView Form with .formStyle(.grouped) and macOS 26 Liquid Glass modifiers.
REQ-013.tasks_rationale: Task 7 explicitly directs upgrading Package.swift and Info.plist to macOS 26.0, migrating OpenKeySettingsStore to @Observable, and refactoring SettingsView with grouped Form and Liquid Glass styling.
REQ-013.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.7 (swift test clean run on macOS 26), Section 2.8 (release bundle build with LSMinimumSystemVersion = 26.0), and Section 2.10 (deployed process lifecycle).

REQ-014.design_rationale: Section 12.1 specifies converting all C++ engine code into pure Swift 6 inside OpenKeySwiftCore (VietnameseData.swift defining OKHookSnapshot, virtual keycodes, bitmasks, phonotactic tables; and VietnameseEngine.swift implementing full syllable state buffer, Telex/VNI syllable composition, checkSpelling, checkRestoreIfWrongSpelling, SmartSwitchKey binary serialization/lookup, and public entry points), deleting OpenKeyEngineBridge, and removing cxxLanguageStandard from Package.swift.
REQ-014.tasks_rationale: Task 8 explicitly directs writing characterization unit tests, implementing VietnameseData.swift and VietnameseEngine.swift in 100% Pure Swift 6 with provenance headers, deleting Sources/OpenKey/macOS-Swift/Sources/OpenKeyEngineBridge/, and updating Package.swift and core imports.
REQ-014.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.7 (pure Swift test suite execution) and Section 2.9 (C++ engine cleanup baseline before Swift port).

REQ-015.design_rationale: Section 12.2 specifies adding a dedicated 'Giới thiệu (About)' section in SettingsView with explicit attribution to Mai Vũ Tuyên's original C++ OpenKey project, adding a status bar menu item in OpenKeySwiftApp, updating NSHumanReadableCopyright in Info.plist, and adding provenance headers to VietnameseData.swift, VietnameseEngine.swift, and README.md.

REQ-015.evidence_rationale: Verified in verification.md Section 2.8 (Info.plist metadata inspection) and Section 2.10 (deployed OpenKeySwift process lifecycle).
